canonical_owner: Existing fenced canonical writer; no independent media authority or second store

shared_reference.name: ArtifactRef
shared_reference.shape_owner: R-Q candidate-contracts.json shared proposal; descriptive types only, no ratified serialization
shared_reference.scope_binding: ContentEnvelope.project_and_audience and ContentEnvelope.privacy_domain_id; project_id is a MemoryProjection field, not an inherited ContentEnvelope base field
shared_reference.external_projection: Newly authorized audience-scoped opaque_handle; never raw digest or stable cross-domain equality

descriptive_types.content_digest: internal content identity; no cross-domain exposure

ContentEnvelope_shared_fields.note: Only these names are reused as the Q base. Additional P provenance fields and T extensions are explicitly separate below. Serialization remains unratified.

media_extension.design_owner: R-T; persistence and current usability remain shared R-Q/R-P/canonical contracts

byte_identity.unknown_rule: Null with reason, never invented final digest for incomplete stream

TransformManifest.all_model_helpers: Explicit eligible route/model/configuration and budget required for OCR, ASR, description, translation, embedding and summary; local does not imply non-inference/offline
TransformManifest.influence_policy: Union all possible visible inputs; generated citations do not prune influence
TransformManifest.constraint_policy: Intersect allowed readers and purposes; retain all incomparable constraints; no automatic declassification

LossManifest.invariant: Property-specific preservation is not semantic equivalence; every derivation carries a record even when unknown

RouteMediaFacet.resolution: Intersect comparable support and limits; apply incomparable dimensions separately; required unknown or semantic conflict blocks. Descriptor cannot widen authority/privacy/egress/rights/billing.

CompiledPayloadManifest.streaming: Preauthorized source/recipient/transform/window/max bytes or duration plus per-segment identities; if exact full-byte preapproval is required use buffering or refuse

unknown_representation.reason: Required source did not report this counter

invariants: Local resources are not money absent approved valuation
Provider token formula is not subscription debit

PartialTransferReceipt.invariant: Socket close, PID exit or local buffer deletion never implies external rollback

rights_and_residuals.completion_rule: R-Q deletion contract; prior external/offline disclosures remain unresolved unless independent scope-specific evidence settles them
rights_and_residuals.counsel_dependency: R-H output-category-specific rights; receipt of bytes does not confer reuse rights

ContentEnvelope_extensions.status: Explicit optional-profile extensions except purpose binding required before protected processing; not inherited Q base
ContentEnvelope_extensions.storage_convention: Logical extension namespace only; no wire serialization selected

retrieval_operation.origin: P ContentEnvelope dimension; absent from Q base
retrieval_operation.validation: Optional carried provenance; resolve exact admitted retrieval operation in the same domain; never a grant

retrieval_time.origin: P ContentEnvelope dimension; absent from Q base
retrieval_time.validation: Typed retrieval observation time/clock quality; do not alias to capture or ingestion time

source_authenticity_evidence.origin: P ContentEnvelope dimension; absent from Q base
source_authenticity_evidence.validation: Evidence reference or explicit unknown; cannot change integrity class or authority without admitted evidence

output_digest.origin: P ContentEnvelope dimension; absent from Q base
output_digest.validation: Compatibility alias only for the produced unit_ref.content_digest within the same domain/algorithm; conflicting values reject; does not replace original parent references

disposition.origin: P ContentEnvelope dimension; absent from Q base
disposition.validation: Projection of current canonical disposition/receipt; not independent writable state

canonical_refs_resolved_separately.origin: P ContentEnvelope dimension/invariant; absent from Q base
canonical_refs_resolved_separately.validation: Invariant true; actual canonical resolver evidence required for use, not self-asserted consent

allowed_purposes.origin: T explicit policy projection extension; Q MemoryProjection has this name, Q ContentEnvelope base does not
allowed_purposes.validation: Required for protected media processing/reuse; intersection of current source retention_rights/purpose decisions. Null/unknown denies protected use; no default wildcard and no grant minting

media_facets.origin: T media extension; not Q base
media_facets.validation: Every representation/selector/loss/quantity field below binds unit_ref, base scope and immutable source/transform identity; reject conflicting duplicate representations

shared_validation: Require every Q base required_name, including project_and_audience and privacy_domain_id; reject missing/unknown required project/audience scope

Do not treat MemoryProjection.project_id as ContentEnvelope.project_id. An unrecognized base field rejects unless a separately versioned compatibility map explicitly admits it and proves equality with project_and_audience project binding
Aliases are revision-bound projections, never competing writable owners; conflicting digest, locator, loss, scope or purpose values reject rather than choosing one
Bind media_facets.source_locators to base source_locator; media_facets.loss_manifest to base coverage_and_loss; byte_identity to unit_ref.content_digest with declared representation and domain
R-Q base and P/T extension maps are proposed and unratified; no library, store, schema wire encoding or new authority chosen
